article.title: Correlación formal As…so…
article.part: Construcciones avanzadas y fenómenos excepcionales — Advanced constructions and exceptional phenomena
article.chapter: Combinaciones avanzadas de cláusulas — Advanced clause combinations

claims.summary: The formal English correlative construction as ... so ... presents two propositions or trends in a parallel or analogous relationship. Its so-clause characteristically features subject–auxiliary inversion, as in As the demand increases, so does the price, with do-support when needed; this correlative so differs from ordinary resultative so and does not by itself establish a causal relation.

links.notes: Formal correlative clause pairing and subject–auxiliary inversion within registered English grammar scope.
